# Image markup reference

Image source, stretch, alignment, and view box.

### Image

Receiver: `Image`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `AlignmentX(ImageAlignmentX value)` | `AlignmentX` | Sets the horizontal alignment of the image. |
| `AlignmentY(ImageAlignmentY value)` | `AlignmentY` | Sets the vertical alignment of the image. |
| `ImageScaleQuality(ImageScaleQuality value)` | `ImageScaleQuality` | Sets the image scaling quality. |
| `OrientationMode(ImageOrientationMode value)` | `OrientationMode` | Sets whether the source's orientation (e.g. JPEG EXIF) is applied; the default FromImage shows the image upright and Ignore the raw decoded pixels. |
| `Source(IImageSource value)` | `Source` | Sets the image source. |
| `SourceFile(string path)` |  | Sets the image source from a file path. |
| `SourceResource(Assembly assembly, string resourceName)` |  | Sets the image source from an embedded resource. |
| `SourceResource(string resourceName)` |  | Sets the image source from an embedded resource using anchor type. |
| `StretchMode(Stretch value)` | `StretchMode` | Sets how the image is stretched to fill available space. |
| `VectorCacheMode(ImageVectorCacheMode value)` | `VectorCacheMode` | Sets how a vector source is rendered; the default is Cached. |
| `ViewBox(Rect? viewBox, ImageViewBoxUnits units = Pixels)` | `ViewBox`, `ViewBoxUnits` | Sets the view box and units. |
| `ViewBoxPixels(Rect? viewBox)` | `ViewBox`, `ViewBoxUnits = Pixels` | Sets the view box with pixel units. |
| `ViewBoxRelative(Rect? viewBox)` | `ViewBox`, `ViewBoxUnits = RelativeToBoundingBox` | Sets the view box with relative units. |
| `ViewBoxUnits(ImageViewBoxUnits value)` | `ViewBoxUnits` | Sets the units for the viewbox coordinates. |
